sample_unit: clinical scenario prompts (169 expected patient care actions)

links.outcome: Accuracy of RAG-grounded LLM prehospital recommendations versus protocol-derived expected actions; hallucinations
links.effect: LLM recommended 127 (75%) of 169 actions; 9 major misses (5%); 12 hallucinations, none judged to endanger patient safety.
links.quote: The LLM recommended 127 (75%) of 169 patient care actions across all cases.

links.outcome: Omission of key clinical actions such as secondary treatable causes in pediatric cardiac arrest
links.effect: Five of nine major misses occurred in the pediatric OHCA case, mostly failure to prompt evaluation of secondary treatable causes.
links.quote: Five of nine major misses occurred during the pediatric OHCA case; the majority of these resulted from failure to prompt evaluation of secondary treatable causes.

screen.reason: Evaluated a RAG-grounded LLM (NotebookLM/Gemini) on simulated prehospital clinical scenario prompts against EMS protocols without comparing with/without a safeguard or deployment practice.
